notes: Four bounded six-hourly opportunities, four workers and two per provider. Up to 400 starts/day before 1500-second launch windows. Local baseline: 80 attempts/184 seconds, 32 successes with mean successful attempt 10.8s and p95 33.7s; fast DNS failures must not be mistaken for success throughput. Reserve 20% of nominal starts for retries. Active/recent recruiting remains Tier 1 12h and Tier 2/3 24h; explicit capacity allocations may lengthen inactive Tier 2 to 4 days/Tier 3 to 7 days, never silently. Runtime/provider limits and no hosted evidence prevent a cadence SLA.
